_about: Multi-sport rollout, standing order 50 (Architect 2026-11-05 21:17-21:23 UK). One new sport a week: Week A = build, backtest, shadow/paper board graded nightly; Week B = LIVE on all three bots (Matchbook, Betfair, SportyBet) wherever the venue lists the market, and the next sport starts its Week A. The gate report is published but a failing gate STILL goes live (Architect: 'a failing gate would still go live'); markets and fixtures that are not bet keep paper-trading and learning, exactly like football. Every sport INHERITS football's and basketball's merged rules and structure: scouts, training, learning, self-improvement, reporting, news, line-ups, the full market catalogue, the three bots' unified rulebook. NO STEAM betting on any new sport, not even paper. tests/standing_orders_test.py guards this file.
week_a: walk-forward backtest (3+ seasons, vs closing price, net of commission, every try counted)
shadow board graded nightly, paper bets on all three bots
nightly retrain on the Oracle clock (routines.TRAINING)
week_b: live on all three bots, money on, undo switch per sport
unbet markets and fixtures stay on paper and keep learning
